---
title: 'Not reported — Monthly panel, other horizons'
format: html
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, arrow, here, polars, DIDmultiplegtDYN)

data <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_monthly.parquet"))
```

## k = 1

```{r}
mm1_nc <- did_multiplegt_dyn(
  df        = data,
  outcome   = "n_installations_per_1000",
  group     = "id",
  time      = "time",
  treatment = "treatment",
  effects   = 1,
  placebo   = 1
)
print(mm1_nc)
```
